implementation.name: original-v1-tensor-memory-layout
implementation.scope: The source 2 × 3 tensor and both alternative serializations. Each cell is one scalar element; offsets count elements. No byte width or cache model is assumed. The logical tensor is a view of either alternative storage, not a third allocation.
implementation.question: How does the same index reach different storage offsets?

purpose: Perform each indexed read against both original alternative layouts; preserve the backing arrays while the returned value travels to the read result.
storyboard: Perform each indexed read against both original alternative layouts; preserve the backing arrays while the returned value travels to the read result.
guard: No tensor copy, cache misses, byte counts, or speedup is inferred from an index mapping.
